name: Why is updating bathroom ventilation so important during a primary remodel?

mainEntity.name: Why is updating bathroom ventilation so important during a primary remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper ventilation is critical in a primary bathroom to remove moisture, prevent mold growth, protect custom cabinetry, and preserve paint finishes. Many older bathrooms rely on undersized or improperly vented fans that dump humid air into attics rather than outside. During a remodel, upgrading to a high-capacity, low-sone exhaust fan rated for the square footage ensures quiet and effective moisture removal. Homeowners can also add humidity-sensing wall switches that run the fan automatically until moisture drops to normal levels, protecting custom tile grout and high-end cabinetry from long-term humidity exposure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrading ventilation prevents moisture damage, mildew, and peeling finishes by ensuring humid air is properly vented outside using an adequately sized, quiet exhaust fan.
